title: Adaptive profile aggregation and synthesized compatibility profiles for HW variants
creator: Maya Singh
description:
Goal: build a lightweight pipeline that ingests per-device benchmark runs and synthesizes a small set of 'compatibility profiles' and an adaptive pin suggestion score for each model+variant across A100/H100/L40S/MI300. These synthesized profiles are intended to reduce onboarding churn, improve auto-pin suggestions for Dedicated customers, and provide a single published artifact consumers can rely on for routing/fallback decisions.

Scope: 1) aggregation step to normalize raw benchmark artifacts (latency distributions, p95/p99, throughput at batch sizes, memory usage, stability events), 2) variance bucketing and stability confidence scoring, 3) generation of human-readable compatibility profiles (e.g., "low-latency-optimized", "high-throughput-binned", "memory-constrained"), and 4) adaptive pin suggestion that maps a confidence score and preferred SLA to an automated pin recommendation (pin / don't-pin / pin-with-caveat).

Constraints & trade-offs: we must keep the published profile JSON small (<10KB) to avoid console and API bloat; use statistically sound but computationally cheap variance estimators (e.g., bootstrap-lite, trimmed mean) to maintain quick publication. Conservative fallback: when sample counts < 30 runs, mark profile as "low-confidence" and require manual review before auto-pinning.

Success metrics: reduction in manual pin reverts by 30% within two cycles, increase in correct auto-pin recommendations (precision) to >85%, and published profile size <10KB in 95% of cases.
acceptance_criteria: Aggregation pipeline ingests benchmark artifacts from existing storage and produces normalized numeric summary per device and model variant
Stability confidence score computed and documented; score thresholds for high/medium/low confidence defined
Generated compatibility profile JSON schema reviewed and approved by PM and runtime team
Adaptive pin suggestion algorithm outputs recommended action and rationale string
End-to-end automated tests that simulate noisy runs and validate that low-sample profiles are flagged for review
Profiles successfully published to the profile registry and surfaced in the Console mockup for QA
tasks: Design aggregation schema and reduced summary fields (latency hist bins, p50/p90/p95/p99, mem peak, oom_count)
Implement variance bucketing and confidence scoring library (python) with simple CIs
Create compatibility profile generator that maps numeric summaries to human labels and pin suggestions
Wire profile publisher into existing profile registry + add API endpoint for synthesized profile retrieval
Add guardrail: low-sample detection and manual review flag in registry metadata
Update Console UI team with sample payload and work with Design to display confidence and recommendation
risks: Small sample sizes lead to wrong pin recommendations — mitigated by low-confidence flag and manual gate
Schema drift between raw benchmark artifacts — mitigate with strict normalization and a lightweight validator
Customers may rely on synthesized labels incorrectly — mitigate by including explicit rationale text + recommended fallback model variants
Publishing too many profile variants could bloat registry — mitigate by restricting synthesized labels to a fixed controlled vocabulary
test_plan: Unit tests for aggregation helpers and confidence scoring with synthetic data
Integration test: full pipeline run against nightly benchmark corpus (A100/H100/L40S/MI300) in CI
Regression test: compare new synthesized profile outputs to golden samples stored in artifacts/
Canary publish: publish to staging registry and surface in staging Console for manual QA
Load test: ensure profile generation and registry publish completes within 30s for a batch of 100 models
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): run pipeline nightly for internal models and produce synthesized profiles; PM/Runtime review for 2 cycles
Phase 2 (limited prod): enable auto-pinning suggestions for non-critical tenants behind a feature flag; monitor pin reverts and stability signals
Phase 3 (general): publish profiles publicly in registry; enable auto-pin recommendations for Dedicated onboarding flows with opt-out
Rollback: feature-flag disable auto-pin, and mark all recently published profiles as 'under-review' in registry

notes: We should consider adding a lightweight time-decay weight to older benchmark runs to prefer recent hardware/driver combos.
Future work: expose 'fallback-variant' suggestions when primary model variant is marked low-confidence or unstable on a particular GPU.
Keep the generated labels actionable (e.g., 'pin-recommended', 'pin-caution', 'do-not-pin') to avoid ambiguous UI states.
